title: Omnigraph
summary: Open source graph database for your AI agents
body: Omnigraph is an open-source object-storage native graph database with branching and typed ontology. It allows AI agents safely collaborate on shared knowledge. Give agents one typed graph with Git-like branching, review, and merge for every write, so changes can be validated before becoming shared context. Run it on your own S3-compatible storage, with semantic, keyword, and hybrid search plus graph traversal in one query. No hosted memory API or proprietary storage required.

title: three.dev
summary: Find out how your AI agent fails. Before your users do.
body: Almost every team now runs AI in production, but few know how it behaves once real users show up. The failures are quiet: a wrong refund policy, a made-up order status. Nothing crashes, so you hear about it from your users. three.dev finds those failures in your live traffic on its own and ranks them by severity. Setup is one prompt to Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. Then your coding agent gets what it needs to write the fix.
